# Welcome to the EHR Research Platform

A comprehensive platform for academic research reporting and interactive data visualization in electronic health records analysis.

</div>

## Project Overview

This research project focuses on developing predictive models for multimorbidity patterns and individual disease risk using large-scale electronic health records (EHR) data. Our work combines machine learning approaches with epidemiological insights to advance understanding of complex disease interactions.

### Research Goals

- **Predictive Modeling**: Develop and validate machine learning models for multimorbidity prediction across diverse disease categories
- **Risk Stratification**: Identify key risk factors and create individualized risk assessment tools
- **Disease Networks**: Map and analyze co-occurrence patterns and temporal relationships between diseases
- **Clinical Translation**: Provide actionable insights for clinical decision-making and preventive care strategies
